## About
Markley Billiards is a pool hall in the Astor Shopping Center, just off Markley Street in Norristown. Look for us on the lower left side of the building, behind the Shell gas station.
Our room and equipment suit pros and novices alike. We play on Simonis cloth that gets vacuumed daily, with Aramith and Centennial balls, under Predator Arena Lights. We're family friendly, with no age requirements.
One longtime regular says the room is physically nicer than ever, and another reviewer says it feels like home. Bring a friend, bring your kids, and stay awhile.

## Services
- Pool tables: 15 tables in all, including Diamond tables in 7, 8 and 9 foot sizes, plus a 9 foot Brunswick Gold Crown V.
- Pro shop: A full pro shop and retail area right in the room.
- Cue brands and special orders: We're dealers for all the major cue brands. If it isn't in stock, we can special order almost any item.
- Tournaments: We host tournaments, and one reviewer says the Friday night tournaments are always fun.

## FAQ
Q: Can I bring my own drinks?
A: Yes. BYOB is up to one six-pack per person, beer and wine only. No hard liquor.

Q: Can kids play?
A: Yes. We're family friendly and there are no age requirements.

Q: Will there be a table for me on a tournament or league night?
A: Yes. No matter if a tournament or league is going on, we always reserve tables for customers who come in to play.
